summary.text: Robyn Kennedy is a Democratic state senator representing the 1st Worcester District, in office since January 2023, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as nonprofit executive.

paragraphs.text: Robyn Kennedy was born in Worcester, Massachusetts, and graduated from Holy Name High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Assumption University in 2003 and a master's degree in public affairs from Clark University in 2021.

Her career experience includes working as associate executive director of mission, programs, and community impact at YWCA Central Massachusetts, as a deputy assistant secretary for children, youth, and families in the Massachusetts Executive Office of Health and Human Services, and as deputy chief of staff in the office of Lieutenant Governor Tim Murray.
Kennedy assumed office in the State Senate on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session she chaired the Joint Committee on Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities and was vice chair of the Joint Committee on Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery.
